observations: carrier.py explicitly describes its P as a parametrization, not a sheet estimate. It combines big with smoothed in-plane displacement from A and smooths positions; normals come from that carrier.

carrier.py crossings uses Surf(up=4) and cross default span60,iters5,miss_max3. p1geom.py implements iterative nearest sampled-cloud projections onto each normal and retains finite offsets only with abs(t)<=60 and miss<3. This is an approximate near crossing, not an exact surface intersection.

carrier.py stores offsets t as float32 and discards the returned miss values. Reconstructed P+t*n may be within producer tolerance of its sampled cloud, but individual residual and original independent surfaces are unavailable from t alone.

Author adoption region in saved surface-decision.json is right line component u~14..23mm. The R225 upper rectangle is u[-6.41664,-0.0576],v[8.58336,12.03936]mm, so right-component agreement rate95.5% cannot be transferred.

Reflatten resamples the carrier. Reusing raw integer indices between the old carrier observations and V5Rc would not establish common physical position. Local geometric correspondence must carry residual/ambiguity and shared CT/m7 provenance.
next_comparison_limit: Sampled observations may constrain a local interpretation, but cannot by themselves prove physical lamina identity or letters. No original lane mesh has yet been independently regenerated.
